mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_reconciliation_operation(tenant_id,operation_no,business_no,actor_key,request_key,request_hash,case_no,action,reason,ticket_ref,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{number},#{businessNo},#{actor},#{key},#{hash},#{caseNo},#{action},#{reason},#{ticket},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_reconciliation_operation.id
mapper.select: SELECT business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_operation WHERE business_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,operation_no,request_hash,case_no,action,channel_id,reference_type,business_ref,case_version,accepted_at,status,last_code,version,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_key=#{actor} AND request_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,operation_no,request_hash,case_no,action,channel_id,reference_type,business_ref,case_version,accepted_at,status,last_code,version,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,operation_no,request_hash,case_no,action,channel_id,reference_type,business_ref,case_version,accepted_at,status,last_code,version,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_no=#{number}
SELECT case_no,channel_id,reference_type,business_ref,status,version,resolution_ref FROM tc_reconciliation_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_no=#{caseNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_reconciliation_case SET status='PROCESSING',resolution_ref=#{number},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_no=#{caseNo} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('OPEN','PROCESSING')

UPDATE tc_reconciliation_operation SET channel_id=#{channel},reference_type=#{type},business_ref=#{reference},case_version=#{caseVersion},accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND accepted_at IS NULL

UPDATE tc_reconciliation_operation SET status=#{status},last_code=#{code},completed_at=CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id,operation_no,request_hash,case_no,action,channel_id,reference_type,business_ref,case_version,accepted_at,status,last_code,version,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status=#{state} AND id>#{after} AND business_no=#{number}operation_no=#{number} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
